notes.title: For Listeners: Now You Can Play Without OBS by Loading Character Sprites
notes.content:
By preparing a 500px x 500px transparent PNG, you can now display characters and play.

How to do it:

1.Create a save data file.
2.After creating the save data, press the options button (gear icon) in the top right corner to load the image.
3.The image will be changed for each save data file.

notes.title: Fixes for Emoji and Post Scrolling Issues
notes.content:
[h2]Fixed Line Break Issues in Emoji-Only Posts[/h2]
We have fixed the line break issues that occurred when posting only emojis. Additionally, some emojis have been corrected. Note: We will continue to make gradual corrections to emojis.

[h2]Scroll Fix for Posts[/h2]
When clicking on Best Post or Day X, we have fixed the issue so that the scroll position now returns to the top when the displayed post changes.

notes.title: Notification: Partial Emoji Support for Posts and Event Replacements
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2Yo6D9yT6Qg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Some Emojis Are Now Available[/h2]
You can now use some emojis when making posts. While not all emojis are available, you can use a selection of them.

Although we have confirmed that there is a bug where emojis can disrupt paragraph formatting, we prioritized the implementation of emojis because we believe it will enhance the gaming experience.

[h2]Post Content Can Now Be Scrolled[/h2]
Since many users enjoy making long posts, we have added a scrollbar. This should allow you to view the entirety of the post content.

[h2]Some Events Have Been Modified[/h2]
We have increased the variety of images for some events and replaced certain events. This update does not affect the gameplay.

We will continue to address emoji-related bugs and add more emojis in the future. Thank you for your continued support of "Buzzing VTuber: Let's Aim for 10K Buzz in the Game!"

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Minor Adjustments
notes.content:
h2]Error: Posts with Line Breaks Not Evaluated Correctly[/h2]
Posts with line breaks were not being evaluated correctly.
As a result, when copied and used, the evaluation might change unexpectedly.

With this update, the issue of evaluations shifting for posts with line breaks has been resolved.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

[h2]Addition of Test Players to Credits[/h2]
The following item has been added to the credits:

notes.title: Notice regarding game release
notes.content:
*Firstly, this game only supports Japanese language.

"バズってVTuber-ゲームでいいから万バズしたい-" has been generating buzz through online news and my social media channels, and we sincerely appreciate it. This announcement contains two points.

[h2]We Recommend Reserving May 21st (Tuesday) for Streaming[/h2]

We had previously announced the release date as May 20th (Monday) through online news and my social media channels.

However, due to my oversight that it is not on May 20th in Japanese time, we are currently unable to provide the exact time to everyone.
As this game is recommended for streaming, we assume there are those planning to stream it.
Therefore, we are informing you in advance.

If you want to schedule streaming reliably, we recommend reserving streaming plans for after May 21st (Tuesday).

Once the release time for May 20th (Monday) is confirmed, we will inform you again.

[h2]Currently, We're Making Final Adjustments to the UI[/h2]

After uploading promotional videos to YouTube Shorts, it was discovered that certain text and screens are not visible on some viewing devices. We are currently adjusting the UI for the May 20th (Monday) release.
While pages with a lot of text will be designed to display properly on various devices, we are improving the UI for the following:

Event descriptions
Posted content
Number of likes
We will adjust so that viewers can see the parts they want to see.
We will handle this to ensure visibility on as many devices as possible.
[h2]In Conclusion[/h2]

This being our first game release on Steam and also the game itself being our first attempt at vertical streaming, it is anticipated that issues may arise in presentation.
However, any problematic areas will be addressed through post-release updates to enhance the experience.

Despite such circumstances, we are excited to release the game and hope that everyone enjoys it.
We appreciate your continued support for "バズってVTuber-ゲームでいいから万バズしたい-".
